spec.title: Everunfold · 日志监控
spec.description: 按服务诊断 HTTP 和任务，按业务观察登录、评论和通知，在日志详情使用 LogQL 定位。

spec.name: http_exclude
spec.label: HTTP 口径
spec.query: 应用请求 : /(health|internal|metrics)(/.*)?|/_next/(static|image)(/.*)?|/favicon\.ico,全部请求 : a^
spec.description: 默认排除健康检查、内部与指标端点和常见静态资源。只作用于 HTTP 统计与 HTTP 诊断面板。

spec.title: HTTP 请求数
spec.description: 各组件的应用访问日志分别计数，排除 Uvicorn 原生重复记录。同一次用户操作可能产生多条请求。

spec.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"fastapi|nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))

spec.title: HTTP 5xx 比例

spec.expr: 100 * (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_status="status" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"fastapi|nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_status=~"[1-5][0-9]{2}" | eu_status=~"5[0-9]{2}" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_status="status" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"fastapi|nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_status=~"[1-5][0-9]{2}" | keep eu_event [$__range])))) / (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_status="status" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"fastapi|nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_status=~"[1-5][0-9]{2}" | keep eu_event [$__range])) > 0)

spec.expr: 100 * (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome", eu_ms="duration_ms" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome="completed" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | eu_ms > ${slow_ms:raw} | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome", eu_ms="duration_ms" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome="completed" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range])))) / (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome", eu_ms="duration_ms" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome="completed" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: 响应状态分布
spec.description: 按状态码类别显示有效响应的每秒速率。

spec.expr: sum by (eu_class) (rate({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_status="status" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_status=~"[1-5][0-9]{2}" | label_format eu_class="{{ trunc 1 .eu_status }}xx" | keep eu_class [5m]))

spec.title: P95 响应耗时
spec.description: 每 5 分钟窗口内已完整发送响应且耗时有效的请求 P95。

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome", eu_ms="duration_ms" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome="completed" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | keep eu_ms | unwrap eu_ms | __error__="" [5m])

spec.title: 连接中断与处理异常
spec.description: 按 outcome 统计。异常与 5xx 可能同时出现在一条记录中。

spec.expr: sum by (eu_outcome) (rate({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome=~"aborted|error" | keep eu_outcome [5m]))

spec.title: 节点请求量 Top 8
spec.description: 按服务器和 node_id 分组，只有带节点 ID 的请求参与排名。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (host, eu_node) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_node="node_id" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_node!="" | keep host, eu_node [$__range])))

spec.title: 节点 5xx Top 8
spec.description: 按服务器和 node_id 统计 5xx 次数。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (host, eu_node) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_status="status", eu_node="node_id" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_status=~"[1-5][0-9]{2}" | eu_node!="" | eu_status=~"5[0-9]{2}" | keep host, eu_node [$__range])))

spec.title: 节点 P95 Top 8
spec.description: 至少 20 条有效耗时样本才参与排名。

spec.expr: topk(8, (quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome", eu_ms="duration_ms", eu_node="node_id" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome="completed" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | eu_node!="" | keep eu_ms, host, eu_node | unwrap eu_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (host, eu_node)) and (sum by (host, eu_node) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_outcome="outcome", eu_ms="duration_ms", eu_node="node_id" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_outcome="completed" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | eu_node!="" | keep host, eu_node [$__range])) >= 20))

spec.title: 同步错误 · 次/分钟
spec.description: 按同步方向统计 event=sync 的错误记录，使用 5 分钟滚动窗口。

spec.expr: 60 * sum by (eu_direction) (rate({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "sync" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_level="level", eu_code="code", eu_direction="direction" | eu_component="nodejs" | eu_event="sync" | eu_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | __error__="" | eu_direction!=""  | keep eu_direction [5m]))

spec.title: 同步错误码 Top 8
spec.description: 以应用诊断日志的 code 分组。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (eu_code) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "sync" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_level="level", eu_code="code", eu_direction="direction" | eu_component="nodejs" | eu_event="sync" | eu_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | __error__="" | eu_code!="" | keep eu_code [$__range])))

spec.title: 同步错误诊断
spec.description: 展示应用给出的错误码、原因与同步操作。

spec.expr: {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "sync" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_level="level", eu_code="code", eu_direction="direction" | eu_component="nodejs" | eu_event="sync" | eu_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | __error__=""

spec.title: 前端 5xx 或连接中断
spec.description: 按时间倒序查看最近 500 条匹配请求。

spec.expr: {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "http_access" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_path="request_url", eu_logger="logger", eu_status="status", eu_outcome="outcome" | eu_event="http_access" | eu_logger!="uvicorn.access" | eu_component=~"nodejs" | eu_path!~`${http_exclude:raw}` | __error__="" | eu_status=~"5[0-9]{2}" or eu_outcome=~"aborted|error"

spec.title: 任务接收
spec.description: task_received 事件数。完整覆盖需要 WORKER_LOG_LEVEL=INFO。

spec.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_received" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_received" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))

spec.title: 已记录的结束
spec.description: task_finished 事件数。重试与后续尝试可分别计入。

spec.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))

spec.title: 已记录的失败
spec.description: task_state=FAILURE 的记录数。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state="FAILURE" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))

spec.title: 已记录的重试
spec.description: task_state=RETRY 的记录数。常规重试需要 INFO 日志。

spec.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state="RETRY" | keep eu_event [$__range]))

spec.title: 已记录的拒绝
spec.description: task_state=REJECTED 的记录数。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state="REJECTED" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))

spec.title: 成功执行 P95
spec.description: Celery SUCCESS 记录的有效执行耗时 P95。需要 INFO 日志。

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_ms="duration_ms" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state="SUCCESS" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | keep eu_ms | unwrap eu_ms | __error__="" [$__range])

spec.title: 任务结束状态 · 次/分钟
spec.description: Celery SUCCESS、FAILURE、RETRY、REJECTED、IGNORED 分开计数。

spec.expr: 60 * sum by (eu_state) (rate({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | keep eu_state [5m]))

spec.title: Worker / Scheduler 运行错误 · 次/分钟
spec.description: 按组件统计 ERROR 及以上的运行日志，排除任务生命周期事件。

spec.expr: 60 * sum by (eu_component) (rate({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_level="level" | eu_component=~"celery|scheduler" | eu_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | eu_event!~"task_received|task_finished" | __error__="" | keep eu_component [5m]))

spec.title: 失败任务 Top 8
spec.description: 只统计 FAILURE 尝试。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (eu_task) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_task="task_name" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_task!="" | eu_state="FAILURE" | keep eu_task [$__range])))

spec.title: 重试任务 Top 8
spec.description: 只统计 RETRY 尝试。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (eu_task) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_task="task_name" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_task!="" | eu_state="RETRY" | keep eu_task [$__range])))

spec.title: 成功任务 P95 Top 8
spec.description: 每个任务名至少 10 条有效 SUCCESS 耗时样本才参与排名。

spec.expr: topk(8, (quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_ms="duration_ms", eu_task="task_name" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state="SUCCESS" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | eu_task!="" | keep eu_ms, eu_task | unwrap eu_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (eu_task)) and (sum by (eu_task) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_ms="duration_ms", eu_task="task_name" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state="SUCCESS" | eu_ms >= 0 | __error__="" | eu_task!="" | keep eu_task [$__range])) >= 10))

spec.title: 队列结束量 Top 8
spec.description: 按日志提供的 queue（投递路由键）统计 task_finished 次数。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (eu_queue) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_queue="queue" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_queue!="" | keep eu_queue [$__range])))

spec.title: 异常队列 Top 8
spec.description: 按 queue 统计 FAILURE、RETRY、REJECTED；缺少 queue 的事件省略。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (eu_queue) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_queue="queue" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_queue!="" | eu_state=~"FAILURE|RETRY|REJECTED" | keep eu_queue [$__range])))

spec.title: 异常 Worker Top 8
spec.description: 按服务器及 Celery worker_hostname 统计失败、重试和拒绝。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (host, eu_worker) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state", eu_worker="worker_hostname" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_worker!="" | eu_state=~"FAILURE|RETRY|REJECTED" | keep host, eu_worker [$__range])))

spec.title: 任务失败、重试、拒绝与忽略
spec.description: 最近 500 条异常尝试。任务 ID 在各次尝试间可相同。

spec.expr: {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "task_finished" | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_state="task_state" | eu_component="celery" | eu_event="task_finished" | __error__="" | eu_state=~"FAILURE|RETRY|REJECTED|IGNORED"

spec.title: Worker / Scheduler 运行错误
spec.description: 最近 500 条 ERROR 及以上的运行记录。

spec.expr: {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} | json eu_component="component", eu_event="event", eu_level="level" | eu_component=~"celery|scheduler" | eu_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | eu_event!~"task_received|task_finished" | __error__=""

spec.title: 匹配记录
spec.description: 输入 LogQL 过滤语句并按回车，服务器和时间范围沿用仪表盘设置。找 5xx：| json | status >= 500。 找请求或任务 ID：|= "具体ID"。表格仅展示可解析的结构化事件，点击单元格可查看较长字段。

spec.expr: {job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} ${logql_filter:raw} | json eu_detail_component="component", eu_detail_severity="level", eu_detail_event="event" | __error__="" | eu_detail_event!="" | eu_detail_component=~"${detail_component:raw}" | eu_detail_severity=~"${detail_level:raw}" | keep host, service_name

spec.title: 业务标记 Top 8
spec.description: 按日志中的 symbol 汇总，供定位相关业务事件。

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (eu_symbol) (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} | json eu_symbol="symbol", eu_event="event" | eu_symbol!="" | __error__="" | keep eu_symbol [$__range])))

spec.title: 登录成功
spec.description: 完成密码登录或二次验证后建立会话。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_stage="business_stage", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"login" | __error__="" | eu_result="success" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_stage="business_stage", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"login" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))

spec.title: 登录失败
spec.description: 记录验证、限流、请求拒绝以及服务错误。二次验证等待单列。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_stage="business_stage", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"login" | __error__="" | eu_result="failure" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_stage="business_stage", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"login" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))

spec.title: 评论提交成功
spec.description: 新评论写入数据库后计数，包含待审核与已公开。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_state="business_state", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"comment_submit" | __error__="" | eu_result="success" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_state="business_state", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"comment_submit" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))

spec.title: 评论提交失败
spec.description: 记录被拒绝或执行失败的提交请求。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_state="business_state", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"comment_submit" | __error__="" | eu_result="failure" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_state="business_state", eu_reason="business_reason" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"comment_submit" | __error__="" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))

spec.title: 邮件成功
spec.description: SMTP 接受邮件。覆盖普通通知和账号安全邮件。

spec.expr: (sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_channel="business_channel", eu_reason="business_reason", eu_type="business_notification_type" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"notification" | __error__="" | eu_channel="email" | eu_result="success" | keep eu_event [$__range])) or (0 * sum (count_over_time({job="docker",service_name=~"(?i).*everunfold.*",host=~`${host:regex}`} |= "business_event" | json eu_event="event", eu_action="business_action", eu_result="business_result", eu_channel="business_channel", eu_reason="business_reason", eu_type="business_notification_type" | eu_event="business_event" | eu_action=~"notification" | __error__="" | eu_channel="email" | keep eu_event [$__range]))))
